clauses.title: 1. APPOINTMENT OF RESELLER AND TERRITORY
clauses.text: 1. APPOINTMENT OF RESELLER AND TERRITORY. Vendor appoints Reseller as a non-exclusive distributor of products within the Western European commercial territory.

clauses.title: 2. RESELLER DISCOUNTS AND PAYMENT CADENCE
clauses.text: 2. RESELLER DISCOUNTS AND PAYMENT CADENCE. Reseller receives a thirty percent (30%) discount off list price, remitting net payment within sixty (60) days of invoice.

clauses.title: 3. MINIMUM ANNUAL SALES QUOTA
clauses.text: 3. MINIMUM ANNUAL SALES QUOTA. Reseller shall achieve annual sales of $500,000.00 USD to maintain tier-one partner status and preferential pricing.

clauses.title: 4. TERMINATION FOR CAUSE OR INACTIVITY
clauses.text: 4. TERMINATION FOR CAUSE OR INACTIVITY. Vendor may terminate upon sixty (60) days notice if Reseller fails to meet minimum sales quotas for two consecutive quarters.
